summary: NatWest Group plc filed a Form 6-K on 2 July 2026 to disclose initial notifications of share purchases by persons discharging managerial responsibility (PDMRs) under Article 19 of the UK Market Abuse Regulation. The Chair and eight non-executive directors purchased ordinary shares at £6.6780 per share on the London Stock Exchange as part of the company's Chairman and Non-executive Director Shareholding Policy. No offer, acquisition, divestiture, or strategic corporate event is reported. This is a routine shareholding notification under UK regulation, equivalent to a periodic filing under US rules. No special-situation elements are present, and no further action or analysis is required.
